output.brief: The crash gap is mostly not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. Only 7.4.0 users can get the flag, and 7.4.0 crashes at about 2% versus 0.7% for 7.3.2. That was already true on 2–3 Sep, before the flag ramp. Within 7.4.0, flag-on users crash 2.10% and the random holdout crashes 1.98%. That 0.12-point difference is within noise. Device mix and usage are the same across groups. The sync-service deploy didn't move 7.3.2 rates. An independent app-store console confirms the gap, so it isn't a reporting artifact. The top crash cluster is a native crash in the upgraded image library (Pixelda, HEIF decoding) that appears only in 7.4.0. Your plan would remove the flag, close the incident, and ship the real problem to 100%. Don't do that. Hold 7.4.0 at 25% and fix the Pixelda crash first. Keep the flag's holdout going, or widen it, to settle whether the flag adds a few tenths of a point of memory kills. Defer the canvas memory rework until that's measured. Don't roll back the crash SDK. Confidence is fairly high. The main remaining uncertainty is a small flag effect.
